analyst_observations: The skill produces consistently structured output (all required fields present) vs baseline which uses ad-hoc schemas

Eval 3 (ambiguous acuerdo/pago) is the discriminating test — both approaches struggle but for different reasons. With-skill misclassifies as reclamo_pago (follows disambiguation table too literally); without-skill gets the right type but with overconfident scoring and no structured reasoning

The nro_siniestro extraction in eval 2 with-skill failed because the STRO reference was embedded in the case caption, not in a standalone field — skill needs to clarify extraction from embedded references

The skill's disambiguation table for acuerdo vs reclamo_pago needs refinement: 'principio de acuerdo pendiente de homologación' should classify as acuerdo even when a deposit is requested, because the agreement itself is the news
